mapper.select: SELECT id, index_id, title, content, author_id, is_deleted, is_hidden, created_at, updated_at FROM articles WHERE index_id = #{indexId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT t.id, t.index_id, t.title, t.content, t.author_id, t.is_deleted, t.is_hidden, t.created_at, t.updated_at FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (index_id) id, index_id, title, content, author_id, is_deleted, is_hidden, created_at, updated_at FROM articles WHERE author_id = #{authorId} ORDER BY index_id, updated_at DESC ) t ORDER BY t.created_at DESC

SELECT t.id, t.index_id, t.title, t.content, t.author_id, t.is_deleted, t.is_hidden, t.created_at, t.updated_at FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (index_id) id, index_id, title, content, author_id, is_deleted, is_hidden, created_at, updated_at FROM articles WHERE title ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY index_id, updated_at DESC ) t ORDER BY t.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE articles SET is_deleted = TRUE WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE articles SET is_deleted = FALSE WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE articles SET is_hidden = TRUE WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE articles SET is_hidden = FALSE WHERE id = #{id}
